description: This file defines the YamlDiscovery class in Drupal, which implements plugin discovery using YAML files, including support for translatable properties.

classes.name: YamlDiscovery
classes.description: Provides YAML-based plugin discovery with support for translatable properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the YamlDiscovery with a filename suffix and directories to scan.

methods.name: addTranslatableProperty
methods.description: Marks a YAML property as translatable and optionally sets its translation context.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves and processes plugin definitions, wrapping specified properties in TranslatableMarkup.
